awards.name: Bank of America Student Leader Award

rationale.intuition: Harvard overall RD admit ~3.4% (SCEA goes earlier, this applicant did not apply early). Pre-SFFA Harvard URM admit rate ~8-12% per Arcidiacono SFFA data. Post-SFFA (2024+) Harvard cannot consider race directly, but contextual review (essays, geographic origin from GA, leadership in voter-registration work) still legally permits indirect URM signal. Industry consensus 5-15% for strong unhooked URM-coded applicant; counselor consensus 5-18%. Lower bound floors at the overall pool; upper bound caps at pre-SFFA URM rate.

sources.name: Arcidiacono SFFA Expert Witness Report 2018
sources.evidence: Pre-SFFA Harvard admitted Black applicants at ~10.4% rate vs Asian-American ~12.7% (controlling for academic index); race conferred 2.5-3× lift over baseline.

sources.name: Harvard CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Overall admit rate 3.41% (Class of 2028); RD admit rate ~3.0%; race no longer reported in admissions data post-SFFA.

sources.name: Common App Year-Over-Year Report 2024
sources.evidence: Harvard URM enrollment dropped ~4pp Class of 2028 vs 2027 (first SFFA cycle); industry estimates URM admit rate now 6-10% absent direct consideration.

sources.name: Crimson Post-SFFA Strategy Guide 2024
sources.evidence: Strong domestic URM applicants with contextual-review signal (geographic, essay-narrated) cluster 7-15% at T5 post-SFFA — narrower band than pre-SFFA but still above unhooked baseline.
